commands:
set -eu
ROOT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work"
echo "MAC_ROOT_HEAD=$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "MAC_ROOT_STATUS=$(git -C "$ROOT" status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
KEY="$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 michal@192.168.0.23 '
  set -eu
  cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
  echo "PI_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  echo "PI_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)"
  echo "PI_DIRTY=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
  echo "PI_DIST_INDEX_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 frontend/dist/index.html | awk "{print \$1}")"
  grep -o "assets/public-map-[^\" ]*js" frontend/dist/index.html | head -1 || :
  echo "SERVICE=$(systemctl is-active photomap.service)"
  echo "TUNNEL=$(systemctl is-active cloudflared.service)"
  systemctl show photomap.service --property MainPID --property NRestarts
  curl -fsS --max-time 6 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
  echo
  curl -fsS --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w "MAP_API_HTTP=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/places/map
'
curl -fsS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w "PUBLIC_HTML_HTTP=%{http_code}\n" https://photomap.pl/
curl -fsS --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w "PUBLIC_HEALTH_HTTP=%{http_code}\n" https://photomap.pl/health
echo "READ_ONLY_RELEASE_STATUS_DONE"
